pieces.text: Count from when it was last done, not from today.

alt: A table of four home maintenance jobs and how often each is really due, beside a short note about counting from the last time a job was done.
caption: Four of the guide's nine jobs, with how often each is really due.

pieces.text: Count every interval from the day it was actually done, not from today.

alt: A table of typical service intervals for a furnace filter, water heater flush, smoke alarms and gutters, beside a note to count from when a job was last done.
caption: Typical U.S. intervals from the guide. Your own manual wins when it says otherwise.

pieces.text: Check the serial number against CPSC's recall list. It takes a minute and needs no registration.

alt: A checklist of five facts to record about a new appliance: brand, model, serial number, purchase and install dates, and warranty end.
caption: The five fields to write down while the appliance is in front of you.

items: Ask who holds the alarm code

pieces.text: Rekey or replace every exterior lock before you move belongings in.

alt: A day-one checklist for a new house covering meter photos, shutoffs, utility suppliers, the alarm code and alarm tests, with a note about changing the locks.
caption: The day-one list from the guide, to do while the previous owner is still reachable.

alt: A table of four months with the home job that belongs to each, including July and August marked as having nothing seasonal, beside a short note.
caption: Four months from the guide's year, including two with nothing to do.

items: Who came, and would you again

lines.label: Wrong?
lines.text: What exactly was wrong with it, in plain words?

lines.label: Next?
lines.text: Is there anything else you'd keep an eye on?

alt: A checklist of six things to write down after a home repair, beside two questions to ask a technician before they leave.
caption: Example. What to write down after a repair, and what to ask before the technician leaves.

pieces.eyebrow: Before you pay for a repair
pieces.text: Check the expiration date first. It turns a surprise into a decision.

alt: A checklist of five things to record when an appliance is installed, beside a note to check the warranty expiration date before paying for a repair.
caption: Example. What to record about an appliance's warranty when it's installed.

pieces.text: Serial 2308-114477 decodes as August 2023 on some brands. Check yours; formats differ.

alt: A checklist of what to photograph on a walk through an undocumented house, beside a note on reading a manufacture date from a serial number.
caption: Example. What to photograph on a first walk through the house, and how to read one serial number format.

pieces.text: Photograph the whole plate. Model, serial and any other code, all in one shot.

alt: A short table of where the model number plate sits on a washer, refrigerator and dishwasher, with a note to photograph the whole plate.
caption: Common plate spots. Brands differ, so check the manual.

steps.what: Book the tune-up, seal gaps, new filter
Clear gutters after the leaves drop

pieces.text: Freeze jobs run on the weather. The rest of the season runs on the month.

alt: A three-step timeline of fall home maintenance: September heating and gaps, October outdoor water and equipment, November gutters.
caption: The fall order. Shift it later in the south.

pieces.text: A freeze is 32°F or below. Finish this list before it arrives, not after.

alt: A five-item winterizing checklist: drain the outdoor faucet, blow out irrigation lines, cover the hose bibs, store the window air conditioner, and replace the humidifier pad.
caption: The winterizing list, before the first hard freeze.

pieces.eyebrow: The habit that keeps it alive
pieces.text: Write it the same day, while you still remember the detail.

alt: A one-page home maintenance log with fields for date, what was done, who did it, what it cost and one note, beside a tip to write it the same day.
caption: The four fields and one note the guide says a log needs.

alt: A card showing a furnace filter's size, location, and the dates it was changed and is due to be checked again, marked as an example, beside a short list of reasons to check it sooner.
caption: Example: one filter's card. The size and dates are placeholders.

alt: A page with blank lines for the main water shutoff, which way it turns, the tool it needs, the gas shutoff and the electrical panel, next to a card comparing a wheel valve and a lever valve.
caption: A page like this takes about ten minutes to fill in.

alt: A binder's table of contents listing five sections, from an emergency page to dates that cost money, next to a note card that says passwords and alarm codes never go in.
caption: The five sections, and the one rule for what stays out.

alt: A day-one checklist for a new rental: photograph every room, write down lease dates, record the deposit, and log what you report, next to an example record showing a deposit amount and notice period.
caption: Example: one household's day-one numbers.
